depiction_rules.notes: Provisional D044 scene-specific supporting-character contract from the supplied D044 reference photos; not an approved character master. Keep the same sage recognizable across the naming-visit scenes.

visual_bible.face: calm, lined, thoughtful face; consistent within D044
visual_bible.hair: silver or white hair gathered in a small ascetic topknot, with a short white beard, following the repeated D044 sage references
visual_bible.build: slender, upright or seated with composed posture
visual_bible.clothing: simple muted saffron or warm-cream ascetic cloth, restrained rudraksha or prayer beads
visual_bible.continuity_markers: same elderly sage face, silver-white gathered hair and short beard, simple ascetic cloth, quiet scholarly demeanor

never: no unreadable or legible writing rendered as text
no duplicate Garga within a scene
do not imply that this is an approved master
